P1.method: Arc smib_swing engine (RK4 h=1e-5): equal-area δ_cr, time-to-δ_cr during fault, bisection CCT; verified via `electrical-engineer run smib-swing-study` with problem.json overrides.

P2.method: Arc smib_swing.simulate_clearing at t_clear=0.25 s, RK4 h=1e-5; peak δ < 180° and instability flag false (t_clear < t_cr from P1).

P3.method: Arc ed_lambda.solve_lambda_ed with sheet unit table (IC = b + 2cP); λ-iteration with limits (U2 and U3 at Pmax).

P4.method: Primary-only identical-area steady partition: Δf = −ΔPL/(β1+β2), ΔP12 = −β2/(β1+β2)·ΔPL with β=21 pu, ΔPL=50 MW, f0=50 Hz; used Arc agc_two_area.analytic_primary_steady for pu tie/mgen, then scaled Δf with f0=50 (engine helper hard-codes 60 Hz).

P5.method: python-control margin() on L(s)=40/(s(s+2)(s+10)); workflow `solve-control-problem` produced Bode/step plots only (no margin numbers).

P6.method: ζ from R,L,C classification; ODE integration of series RLC state (vc,i) for 12 V step — ngspice unavailable (`simulate-circuit` returned unchecked).

P7.method: Arc power_runner._sequence_fault SLG: |I|=3|V|/|Z1+Z2+Z0+3Zf|; kA from 100 MVA, 33 kV LL base I=1.75 kA. CLI fault workflow failed on string complex z_pu.

P8.method: Exact per-phase equivalent circuit at s=0.04 (star Vph); s_max from Thevenin toward rotor branch. Arc drives_study only supports slip-from-load torque, not full EC.
